text:
Monica Chen: urgent — noticed embed p95 spike in EU1 after last canary, looks like kv-cache TTL misfire. I want to push v13.2.1.1 as a hotfix quickpath. Can we fastlane? @Raj @Kevin

deploy-bot: Release started: v13.2.1.1 (sha: abc123def) -> canary eu1. Steps: canary -> 50% -> full. CI checks running. (If you need to abort: /deploy cancel)

Raj Patel: what's the rollback criteria and command? need that before i sign off.

Monica Chen: rollback criteria: error rate > 1% OR p95 > 300ms for 5m window. rollback command: kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/embeddings --to-revision=42. quick changelog: KV cache TTL fix + quant kernel fallback for short sequences. release note draft: https://internal.redwood/releases/13.2.1.1

Kevin Lopez: i can +1 expedited if Marie watches telemetry and we have the rollback steps posted in the runbook. @Marie O'Connor? :eyes:

Marie O'Connor: i'm on telemetry. will monitor traces and synthetic checks. will call abort if we see regressions. current canary will need 5m stable to greenlight.

deploy-bot: Canary health update: 30/30 health checks passing; avg p95 140ms (baseline 130ms) at t+2m.

Dave Huang: tagging security & support FYI — no data schema changes in this patch.

Monica Chen: starting 50% traffic shift now.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift to 50% complete. Canary -> 50%. Autoscaling checks normal.

Marie O'Connor: 3m into 50% window — p95 trending to baseline, traces show KV TTL refreshes fixed. No errors. continuing to watch.

Raj Patel: +1 from me for full rollout. rollback steps noted.

Kevin Lopez: +1. go ahead. keep the oncall loop open for next 10m.

Monica Chen: moving to full rollout. release note: "13.2.1.1 — urgent KV cache TTL fix to mitigate embed latency spikes; improves EU1 p95. Backwards compatible. See changelog: https://internal.redwood/releases/13.2.1.1/notes"

deploy-bot: Release complete: v13.2.1.1 deployed to prod eu1 at 1834567600. No rollbacks. CI: all checks passed.

Marie O'Connor: confirming post-rollout metrics look stable. closing monitoring watch in 10m.

Monica Chen: thanks team — will publish a short release note and ping support for customer comms. :tada:
